OUR IMPACT

## We transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and
## health.

[ Our Purpose ][124]
* [
  Mobility
  [An aerial view of a highway with moving traffic.]
  We play a fundamental role in advancing the future of mobility on the road, in the air and in
  orbit—from critical materials that power battery systems, to safety components like airbag
  initiators, and more.
  ][125]
* [
  Energy
  [Aerial night view of a bustling city with illuminated skyscrapers, roads, and a few cars,
  showcasing a vibrant urban landscape.]
  We support the build-out of energy storage systems that help power data centers and ensure a more
  reliable grid.
  ][126]
* [
  Connectivity
  [A view of earth from space at night showing the planet's curved horizon. Some clouds are
  illuminated by city lights. Clusters of city lights showing in certain areas looking like
  connected light streams.]
  We enhance safety and reliability in connections, from fire safety compounds in electronics, wires
  and cables to the protective glass on phones.
  ][127]
* [
  Health
  [Grocery store produce isle]
  We produce specialty chemicals and additives for medicines, disinfectants and solutions that keep
  our food and water safe and plentiful.
  ][128]
ALBEMARLE BY THE NUMBERS


## A Global Footprint, Built for Reliable Supply

[Photo of green trees for Albemarle Sustainability 2024]

SUSTAINABILITY

## A Sustainable Future

We’re committed to sustainability in all that we do, transparently sharing insights into our
sustainability strategy, objectives and accomplishments. Our approach to environmental stewardship,
responsible sourcing, community engagement and employee welfare is a daily pursuit across all
aspects of our organization.

Our innovative technologies and practices minimize our environmental footprint and ensure a
sustainable supply of critical minerals for the future while minimizing our environmental impact
today.

[ Direct Lithium Extraction ][129] [ Sustainability at the Salar Plant ][130] [ Albemarle 2025
Sustainability Report ][131]
[A female scientist in a lab coat conducts an experiment in an industrial setting, interacting with
equipment while examining a sample in a mixing dish.]

## Let's Build a More Resilient World Together

Albemarle attracts people who want to do well by doing good. As a leader in our industries we invite
you to explore our career opportunities worldwide. 

[ View Careers ][132]
All the elements for a better world.

today.

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

### Sulphur & Water Chemicals (SWC)

[READ MORE][91]

### Electrochemicals (EC)

[READ MORE][92]

## Product Applications

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

* [product application banner] *

### Industries we serve include:

Water and Wastewater Treatment, Food, Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Oil & Gas, Industrial Processing,
Agriculture, and more.

[Read More][93]

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

## Industries we serve

[

### Agriculture

Hexion’s innovative resin technologies enable controlled, slow-release fertilizers that improve
nutrient efficiency, crop yield, and environmental sustainability.

Read our case study

### Agriculture

][42][

### Automotive

Our high-performance resins and adhesives drive innovation in lighter, safer, and more
energy-efficient vehicles.

Read our case study

### Automotive

][43][

### Building Materials

High-performance materials engineered to improve strength, durability, and sustainability in modern
construction applications.

Read our case study

### Building Materials

][44][

### Coatings & Paint

Our advanced monomers enable durable, high-quality coatings with optimized performance and
compliance.

Read our case study

### Coatings & Paint

][45][

### Equipment Solutions

Integrated equipment and process solutions designed to enhance efficiency, reliability, and
performance in industrial operations.

Read our case study

### Equipment Solutions

][46][

### Formalin

Essential formalin solutions produced with a focus on quality, consistency, and responsible
manufacturing.

Read our case study

### Formalin

][47][

### Mining

Our robust systems improve safety, efficiency, and environmental performance in the world’s most
demanding extraction environments.

Read our case study

### Mining

][48][

### Oil & Gas

Hexion chemistry delivers strength and reliability under pressure—enhancing drilling performance,
well integrity, and operational safety.

Read our case study

### Oil & Gas

][49][

### Wood Panels

Innovative resin systems designed to improve panel performance, productivity, and sustainability
across wood-based products.

Read our case study

### Wood Panels

][50]

## Science with Purpose, Sustainability with Soul.

At Hexion, we don’t make empty promises; we drive measurable, year-over-year progress to protect our
environment and empower the professionals who are behind it.

Shrinking Our Footprint,
Not Our Ambition

By prioritizing energy efficiency and circularity, we aim for measurable reductions in emissions and
resource use every single year, even if that means rethinking our legacy formulas from the ground
up.

With you anything is possible

We are looking for the curious, the bold, and the nerds who want to question the status quo. If you
are ready to grow, we provide the safety, well-being, and technical tools to help you reach your
full potential.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Ceramics

Since our inception more than 40 years ago, we have been specializing in stocking and supplying
Chemicals, Minerals, Solvents etc. for Ceramics, Glass, Tiles, Insulators, Sanitarywares, Bone
China, Stoneware, Ceramic Frits and Colour manufacturers. Our experience and expertise in this field
are unmatched. All requirements of the Ceramic Industry are available under one roof. We have ready
stocks in Delhi, of all chemicals & Solvents required in the Ceramic Industry. We have tie-ups with
renowned manufacturers of Chemicals in India and abroad to cater to all the needs of our valued and
esteemed customers. In other words we are complete solution providers for all Ceramic Units.

List of Chemicals required in the Ceramic Industry:

* All Other Chemicals
Quality Standards

the best quality of Chemicals, Solvents etc. and that too within the stipulated period of time. Our
team of quality controllers keeps a stringent check on all the quality attributes. They carry out
inspection and study of each and every chemical in detail so that only the desired and most suitable
products reach our clients. It is seen to it that only goods of the correct weight are despatched
and the packing is strong enough to stand the transit strain. In order to maintain high quality
standards which we have set for ourselves, all our chemicals are sourced from reputed manufacturers
only so that they are not subjected to any rejections at any stage. Our range is checked on various
parameters such as :
* Purity
* Moisture Content
* pH Value
* Solubility
* Density

* Unmatched experience of over 45 years

  city
* Highly efficient staff with years of experience.
* Wide Distribution network
* Competitive Rates

# Tips to browse safely online

Here you'll find some basic tips to protect your privacy and reduce the ability for people to see
what you do online.

## The 'Close this site' button

Some pages on this website include a 'Close this site' button. Use this button to quickly hide what
you are looking at. You might find this helpful if someone comes into the room or looks over your
shoulder and you don't want them to know what you've been looking at.

When you use the 'Close this site' button, it immediately closes this website and opens the Google
search page in a new window.

You can also quickly close this site by using the **ESC **button on your computer keyboard. It
immediately closes this website and opens the Google search page in a new window.

The 'Close this site' function doesn't delete your browser history. This means that if someone
checks your browser history on your computer or mobile device, they will be able to see everything
you looked at on our website.

## Clear your browsing history regularly

Web browsers keep track of your online activity through your browser history, cookies and caching.
This is so you can find websites you've visited before, but it also means other people can see this
data.

To protect your privacy, it's a good idea to clear your browsing history regularly. You can choose
to delete everything or only some things.

Find out how to clear your browsing history in:
* [Internet Explorer][75]
* [Google Chrome][76]
* [Firefox][77]
* [Safari][78]
* [Safari on iPhones or iPads][79].

For other browsers and devices, check the provider's website.

## Use private browsing

Private browsing is an easy way to hide your browsing habits. If enabled, when you close your
browser, all browsing history and stored cookies from future browsing sessions will automatically
disappear.

However, the sites you visited during your current browsing session will record your browsing
activity. Your internet service provider will also record this information. Any files you download
using private browsing won't be deleted, so other people can access them if they use your device.

Find out how to enable private browsing in:
* Internet Explorer
  * In the 'Tools' menu (the cog icon on top right of the browser window), select 'Safety', then
    'InPrivate Browsing'.
* [Google Chrome][80]
* [Firefox][81]
* [Safari][82]
* [Safari on iPhones or iPads][83].

For other browsers and devices, check the provider's website.

## Accounts and passwords

Don't let your browser auto-save your passwords. While the auto-save function may be convenient, it
gives anyone who uses your device access to your accounts.

When you are using an account with a password (e.g. your social media or email account), always log
out before leaving the website.

## Using other computers and devices

If you are worried about someone looking at your internet use, consider using a computer or device
that they can't access.

This might be a computer at your local library, your work computer, or a family or friend's device.

# Tips to browse safely online

Here you'll find some basic tips to protect your privacy and reduce the ability for people to see
what you do online.

## The 'Close this site' button

Some pages on this website include a 'Close this site' button. Use this button to quickly hide what
you are looking at. You might find this helpful if someone comes into the room or looks over your
shoulder and you don't want them to know what you've been looking at.

When you use the 'Close this site' button, it immediately closes this website and opens the Google
search page in a new window.

You can also quickly close this site by using the **ESC **button on your computer keyboard. It
immediately closes this website and opens the Google search page in a new window.

The 'Close this site' function doesn't delete your browser history. This means that if someone
checks your browser history on your computer or mobile device, they will be able to see everything
you looked at on our website.

## Clear your browsing history regularly

Web browsers keep track of your online activity through your browser history, cookies and caching.
This is so you can find websites you've visited before, but it also means other people can see this
data.

To protect your privacy, it's a good idea to clear your browsing history regularly. You can choose
to delete everything or only some things.

Find out how to clear your browsing history in:
* [Internet Explorer][75]
* [Google Chrome][76]
* [Firefox][77]
* [Safari][78]
* [Safari on iPhones or iPads][79].

For other browsers and devices, check the provider's website.

## Use private browsing

Private browsing is an easy way to hide your browsing habits. If enabled, when you close your
browser, all browsing history and stored cookies from future browsing sessions will automatically
disappear.

However, the sites you visited during your current browsing session will record your browsing
activity. Your internet service provider will also record this information. Any files you download
using private browsing won't be deleted, so other people can access them if they use your device.

Find out how to enable private browsing in:
* Internet Explorer
  * In the 'Tools' menu (the cog icon on top right of the browser window), select 'Safety', then
    'InPrivate Browsing'.
* [Google Chrome][80]
* [Firefox][81]
* [Safari][82]
* [Safari on iPhones or iPads][83].

For other browsers and devices, check the provider's website.

## Accounts and passwords

Don't let your browser auto-save your passwords. While the auto-save function may be convenient, it
gives anyone who uses your device access to your accounts.

When you are using an account with a password (e.g. your social media or email account), always log
out before leaving the website.

## Using other computers and devices

If you are worried about someone looking at your internet use, consider using a computer or device
that they can't access.

### **關於 Amala Group**

Amala Group
為害蟲防治、深度消毒及清潔、空氣淨化需求提供一站式的解決方案。我們的專業人員在物業管理領域上擁有超過
20
年的經驗。我們的專長是害蟲防治服務，專門針對常見害蟲進行防護，包括白蟻、螞蟻、床蝨、蟑螂和各種有害昆
蟲。除了蟲害防治，我們還提供度身訂制的計劃，以幫助改善客戶家居和企業的整體衛生和空氣質素。
我們以超出客戶預期的國際級服務而自豪。我們從上到下、從裡到外檢查客戶的家居和企業是否存在當前或潛在的
衛生問題。我們會就提供的服務作出詳細的報告和建議，以幫助客戶的家居和辦公室遠離害蟲和病毒。我們還會定
期訪問客戶及保持聯繫，並對任何緊急需求作出支援。 在
Amala，我們相信保護地球環境同時幫助防治客戶家居和企業中的害蟲是我們的責任。

### **關於 Amala Group**

Amala Group
為害蟲防治、深度消毒及清潔、空氣淨化需求提供一站式的解決方案。我們的專業人員在物業管理領域上擁有超過
20
年的經驗。我們的專長是害蟲防治服務，專門針對常見害蟲進行防護，包括白蟻、螞蟻、床蝨、蟑螂和各種有害昆
蟲。除了蟲害防治，我們還提供度身訂制的計劃，以幫助改善客戶家居和企業的整體衛生和空氣質素。
我們以超出客戶預期的國際級服務而自豪。我們從上到下、從裡到外檢查客戶的家居和企業是否存在當前或潛在的
衛生問題。我們會就提供的服務作出詳細的報告和建議，以幫助客戶的家居和辦公室遠離害蟲和病毒。我們還會定
期訪問客戶及保持聯繫，並對任何緊急需求作出支援。 在
Amala，我們相信保護地球環境同時幫助防治客戶家居和企業中的害蟲是我們的責任。

An Innovation-driven company, which has always taken the position of thought leadership since the
last 65 years and have been tailoring solutions to solve problems across industries which include
Plywood, Woodworking, Animal Feed, Abrasives, Foundries, Refractories, Friction Materials, Advanced

## Insights

[Techco - Cases Image]
* [[Techco - Cases Image]][171]

### [A READY MADE SOLUTION FOR VARIED NEEDS][172]

STRONGBOND ONE SHOT is a pre-catalysed Amino Plastic Resin with much Superior Performance over
traditional PVAC resins. It is tailored to meet specific customer needs, such as High Moisture
Resistance, Warm Water Resistance, and Low Formaldehyde Emission.

[ Know More ][173]
[Techco - Cases Image]
* [[Techco - Cases Image]][174]

### [Carb P2 Compliance][175]

CARB P2 Compliance as per ASTM indicates that a product’s formaldehyde emissions are within the
allowable limits specified by CARB, which are among the strictest in the world. Calibrated and
non-calibrated plywood manufactured with a couple of resin formulations of ARCL meet CARB P2
Compliance and thus, contribute to healthy air quality. They adhere to stringent health and
environmental safety standards vis-à-vis formaldehyde emissions, enhancing its appeal for
international markets and supporting export initiatives

[ Know More ][176]
[Techco - Cases Image]
* [[Techco - Cases Image]][177]

### [Formaldehyde 43%][178]

ARCL is one of the few players having the knowhow of producing 43% Formalin. Using Formaldehyde 43%
in liquid resin gives a lot of advantages compared to using the usual 37% formalin.
*  **More solid content in resin, resulting in 16% stronger material**
*  **12% more productivity**
* 
*  **Better Polymerization **
* 
*  **Enhanced Bonding**

* **Committed to Greener and Innovative Solutions **
* Led by innovative ideas and a vibrant work culture, our R&D team is composed of some of the best
  young talents in the industry, guided by seasoned organic chemists and interdisciplinary subject
  experts. We are dedicated to the global cause of creating a greener tomorrow while driving
  industry success.

### Milestones

### Evolving Through Years

### 1959

ARCL was born, beginning with a technical collaboration with Borden Chemicals (Now Hexion) UK/USA,
for the production of spray-dried UF Resin powder and the entire range of thermosetting resins. The
collaboration lasted for 20 years. UF resin powder was made for the first time in Asia.

### 1960

We got a Formaldehyde Plant from Japan Gas (now Mitsubishi Gas). It was the first such plant in
India.

### 1970

Formaldehyde plant from LEUNA Germany.

### 1983

The present group Chairman - Mr. S.R. Mundhra took over the Management and revived the sick company.

### 1993

Metal oxide-based formaldehyde plant, Paraformaldehyde plant and UFC-85 from Alder SPA Italy.

### 1994

Allied Resins went public with the premium issue and listing at Bombay Stock Exchange, National
Stock Exchange and Calcutta Stock Exchange.

### 1995

PF spray-dried powder technology from Bokem INC, Montreal, Canada through Mr K K Sudan including
relocation of ANHYDRO make spray drier.

### 2003

Bought the resin business of Ciba-Atul (A collaboration between Atul Ltd. and Ciba Geigy from

### [A READY MADE SOLUTION FOR VARIED NEEDS][172]

STRONGBOND ONE SHOT is a pre-catalysed Amino Plastic Resin with much Superior Performance over
traditional PVAC resins. It is tailored to meet specific customer needs, such as High Moisture
Resistance, Warm Water Resistance, and Low Formaldehyde Emission.

[ Know More ][173]
[Techco - Cases Image]

### [Carb P2 Compliance][175]

CARB P2 Compliance as per ASTM indicates that a product’s formaldehyde emissions are within the
allowable limits specified by CARB, which are among the strictest in the world. Calibrated and
non-calibrated plywood manufactured with a couple of resin formulations of ARCL meet CARB P2
Compliance and thus, contribute to healthy air quality. They adhere to stringent health and
environmental safety standards vis-à-vis formaldehyde emissions, enhancing its appeal for
international markets and supporting export initiatives

### [Formaldehyde 43%][178]

ARCL is one of the few players having the knowhow of producing 43% Formalin. Using Formaldehyde 43%
in liquid resin gives a lot of advantages compared to using the usual 37% formalin.
*  **More solid content in resin, resulting in 16% stronger material**
*  **12% more productivity**

### Evolving Through Years

### 1959

ARCL was born, beginning with a technical collaboration with Borden Chemicals (Now Hexion) UK/USA,
for the production of spray-dried UF Resin powder and the entire range of thermosetting resins. The
collaboration lasted for 20 years. UF resin powder was made for the first time in Asia.

### 1960

We got a Formaldehyde Plant from Japan Gas (now Mitsubishi Gas). It was the first such plant in
India.

### 1970

Formaldehyde plant from LEUNA Germany.

### 1983

The present group Chairman - Mr. S.R. Mundhra took over the Management and revived the sick company.

### 1993

Metal oxide-based formaldehyde plant, Paraformaldehyde plant and UFC-85 from Alder SPA Italy.

Allied Resins went public with the premium issue and listing at Bombay Stock Exchange, National

White Crystalline Solid, extensively used as fumigant, disinfectant and adhesives. Being an
extremely flammable and high friction product, our paraformaldehyde prills are delivered in premium
anti-static LDPE bags to ensure zero hazards.

sectors. Our exhaustive quality control checks and product testing verifies that each lot is
consistently top grade.

### Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85%

Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85% or UFC85 is a clear & viscous liquid with immense benefits. It
is a unique blend of formaldehyde, urea & water in the ratios 60%, 25%, 15% respectively. It is
effectively used in a range of applications from the production of urea-formaldehyde resins to being
used as an anti-caking agent for the urea fertilizer.

Formaldehyde manufacturing facilities in India. We are capable of delivering best in class 3L MTPA
Formaldehyde and 20K MTPA Paraformaldehyde. To ensure our commitment toward a greener and cleaner
future all our facilities are State Laws and EPA compliant.

materials to finished goods, the quality we deliver is unmatched & thoroughly consistent.

## Our
## Specialities

### Formaldehyde

Formaldehyde has a variety of derivatives that find applications in the chemical industry and also
in the production of textile binders and paints. Its versatility, excellent binding grip and
preservative properties have made it popular in the paper and laminates market.

### Paraformaldehyde

White Crystalline Solid, extensively used as fumigant, disinfectant and adhesives. Being an
extremely flammable and high friction product, our paraformaldehyde prills are delivered in premium
anti-static LDPE bags to ensure zero hazards.
We offer Best in Class 96% Paramformaldehyde prills for catering to a diverse range of industrial
sectors. Our exhaustive quality control checks and product testing verifies that each lot is
consistently top grade.
* [25kgs LDPE Bags]
  25kgs LDPE Bags
* [500/1000 Anti Static Jumbo Bags]
  500/1000 Anti Static Jumbo Bags
* [Custom Sizing Options Available]
  Custom Sizing Options Available

[25 KG LPG bag of Paraformaldehyde]

### Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85%

Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85% or UFC85 is a clear & viscous liquid with immense benefits. It
is a unique blend of formaldehyde, urea & water in the ratios 60%, 25%, 15% respectively. It is
effectively used in a range of applications from the production of urea-formaldehyde resins to being
used as an anti-caking agent for the urea fertilizer.
* [250 Kgs. Barrel]

## Powerhouse

Sprawling across 20 acres in Gujarat & Maharastra, we have one of the largest Paraformaldehyde and
Formaldehyde manufacturing facilities in India. We are capable of delivering best in class 3L MTPA
Formaldehyde and 20K MTPA Paraformaldehyde. To ensure our commitment toward a greener and cleaner
future all our facilities are State Laws and EPA compliant.

[Know More][17]
[vector]

## Quality Par
## Excellence

With mammoth production comes the great challenge of ensuring purity and consistency. We are the
only Paraformaldehyde facility in India & South Central Asia with ISO 9001,14001 & 45001
Certifications. With over 200 skilled minds and a rigorous quality testing process starting from raw
materials to finished goods, the quality we deliver is unmatched & thoroughly consistent.

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

**Changyu Pump** is a trusted **chemical pump manufacturer** established in 2006, specializing
in corrosion-resistant pump solutions for aggressive and complex fluids. Our main products
include magnetic drive pumps, centrifugal pumps, self-priming pumps, slurry pumps, and submersible
pumps, widely used in chemical processing, electroplating, wastewater treatment, mining, and
environmental applications.

Backed by strong manufacturing capability and industry experience, we help global customers improve
fluid transfer safety, reduce leakage risk, and achieve long-term operating reliability with
professional **industrial pump systems** and customized service.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V
Frequency: _________Hz
Power:_____________KW

Q: What is your minimum quantity?

A: One set is also welcomed to us.

Q: How long is warranty?

A: 1 year for main construction warranty.

Q: What is your lead time?

A: Normally 10 days. If client is in urgent, we have plenty of spare parts, we could finish
assembling and testing in 3-5 days.

Q: What about shipment or delivery?

A: Depends on customer’s requirements, We can do EXW, FOB, CIF,etc.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V

Q: What is your minimum quantity?

A: One set is also welcomed to us.

Q: How long is warranty?

A: 1 year for main construction warranty.

Q: What is your lead time?

A: Normally 10 days. If client is in urgent, we have plenty of spare parts, we could finish
assembling and testing in 3-5 days.

A: Depends on customer’s requirements, We can do EXW, FOB, CIF,etc.

Welcome to Chemanol
[Welcome to Chemanol][127]

Chemanol is one of the world’s most integrated and reliable global producers of methanol and
derivatives. Chemanol is also one of the world’s largest formaldehyde producers situated in a single
location, and the biggest producer in the GCC. The Company’s products have applications as diverse
as agriculture, automobiles, pharmaceuticals and construction.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about eChemNetwork, business listings, chemical suppliers,
manufacturers, buyers, membership, and advertising services.

## ? What is eChemNetwork?

eChemNetwork is a global B2B platform connecting chemical, pharmaceutical, industrial, laboratory,
engineering, manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, importers, distributors, buyers, and service
providers worldwide.

## ? Is registration free?

Yes. Companies can create a business profile free of charge. Premium membership and advertising
plans are available for additional exposure and lead generation.

## ? How can buyers contact suppliers?

Buyers can search products or companies and submit inquiries directly through supplier profile pages
and product listings.

## ? Can I advertise my company?

Yes. eChemNetwork offers Featured Listings, Banner Advertising, Sponsored Products, Digital
Marketing, Email Marketing, and various branding opportunities.

## ? Which industries are covered?

Chemical, Pharmaceutical, API, Agrochemical, Petrochemical, Laboratory, Specialty Chemicals,
Engineering, Packaging, Industrial Equipment, and many other sectors.

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

  # Pure Progress
  
  Foremark leads the way in the sustainable manufacturing of products supporting the transition to a

  progress to our customers, our markets, and our communities.

  ][10]

  # Pur-EST^{®} Scavengers
  
  Foremark launches newly patented Pur-EST^{®}, our next generation of gas sweetening technology
  materially contributing to the increased consumption of natural gas clean energy.
  
  Learn more about our Pur-EST® Scavengers
  ][11]

  # Advancing chemistry with accuracy.
  
  As a leader in specialty chemicals for natural gas scavenging and intermediates for petrochemical
  applications, we provide environmentally sound innovative solutions to our customer’s needs,
  faster and more accurately.
  
  Learn more about Foremark
  ][12]

  # North America’s largest merchant producer of formalin
  
  As one of the leading formalin suppliers, we operate the second largest plant in North America.
  
  Learn more about formalin
  ][13]

  Outperform with Pur-EST^{®}, PureMark^{®}, and ScavGen^{®} scavengers, our innovative and high

#### Key Points/Overview

## Formaldehyde

All life forms–bacteria, plants, fish, animals and humans–naturally produce formaldehyde as part of
cell motabolism.

Formaldehyde is one of of the most well-studied and well-understood compounds in commerce. Federal
agencies including FDA, EPA, OSHA and the Consumer Product Safety Commission have extensively
evaluated the safety of formaldehyde and approved its use in a variety of applications.

## Uses and Benefits

Formaldehyde is an essential building block chemical in the production of hundreds of items that
improve everyday life. Little, if any, formaldehyde remains in the final products that consumers
use.

## Agriculture

Across the agricultural industry, formaldehyde helps us to access safe meat, poultry, and
aquaculture products.

## Automobiles

Formaldehyde technology helps make vehicles lighter and more energy efficient. Formaldehyde-based
resins are used to make interior molded components .

## Health Care Applications

Formaldehyde has a long history of safe use in the manufacture of vaccines, anti-infective drugs and
hard-gel capsules.

## Personal Care and Consumer Products

Formaldehyde-based chemistry is essential in the production of many personal care 1 and consumer
items.

## Building and Construction

Formaldehyde-based resins are used to manufacture composite and engineered wood products used
extensively in cabinetry, countertops etc.

### FAQ:

Do I need to download software for conference calls?

FreeConference.com prioritizes user-friendliness, allowing both participants and hosts to access
conference calls directly through their browsers. No download is required.

Joining a conference call is as simple as clicking a link in your web browser. This is particularly
convenient for situations where participants might be using different devices or operating systems.

However, while downloads aren't required, FreeConference.com does offer a downloadable conference
call software for desktop and mobile apps that provide additional features and functionalities for
those who prefer them.

How many participants can join a free conference call?

FreeConference.com’s conference calling solution offers a variety of plans to suit different
conferencing needs, with varying capacities for participants. Here's a breakdown of the number of
participants allowed on each plan:
* **Free Plan:** This plan is ideal for small meetings and casual catch-ups. It generously allows up
  to 100 conference call participants, meaning you can have a large group on the phone line.
  However, there's a limit of 5 web participants, which refers to those joining the free conference
  through their web browser with video capabilities.
* **Paid Plans:** FreeConference.com offers paid plans starting at $9.99 per month, providing
  increased capacity for both call participants and web participants. These plans are well-suited
  for businesses that conduct regular conferences or webinars with larger audiences. The paid
  "Starter" plan limits the number of web participants by 15, while allowing 100 call participants.
  However, the Pro plan (starting at 29.99/month) can support up to 250 call participants and 250
  web participants, allowing for truly large-scale online meetings.

By considering the number of participants you typically need for your conference calls, you can
choose the FreeConference.com plan that best fits your requirements.

Is there a time limit on conference calls?

FreeConference.com boasts one of the most generous time limits for free conference calling services.
While some platforms cap free conference calls at short durations, FreeConference stands out by
offering the maximum call time of 12 hours. That means you can host extended conference calls or
lengthy collaborations without worrying about the call terminating abruptly.

Can I record meetings, and are there any extra charges?

Yes, FreeConference.com does allow you to record your conference calls, and there are only paid
options in different tiers, depending on your needs.

**How to Record:**
* **Phone Calls:** If you're on a phone-only call, dial *9 to start the recording and *9 again to
  stop.
* **Web Conferences (including Video):** Within your online meeting room, locate the "Record"
  button. Click to start and stop recording.

**Starter Plan Recording Options:**

FreeConference.com’s conference calling software does offer limited recording capabilities with our
starter plan. With this plan you can only record audio files (MP3). You can store a limited number
of recordings (5GB) on the platform.

**Pro Plan Recording Options:**

FreeConference.com's pro plan offers extended recording features that increase both storage volume
and recording capabilities. With this plan, recordings can be played back directly via the platform,
making it easier to review and share. Additionally, this plan allows you to record video format
(MP4) and screen sharing. Moreover, you will have an increased storage capacity (10GB).

Can I use free conference calls internationally?

Yes, FreeConference.com is a convenient conference call solution for holding international
conference calls. We offer toll-free dial-in numbers for several countries, including:
* United States
* Canada
* Germany
* Australia
* Singapore
* United Kingdom

Here's why this is a great option:
* **Global Dial-in Numbers:** Participants can dial a local FreeConference.com number, avoiding
  expensive international charges. Check their website for a complete list of supported countries.
* **Free for Callers:** The free plan offers a selection of international dial-in numbers, meaning
  participants won't incur calling charges.
* **Upgraded Plans = More Countries:** Paid plans expand your options, with even more international
  dial-in numbers available. Choose a plan based on the countries you frequently connect with.

**How it Works**
* You, as the host, use your regular login details.
* International participants dial their local FreeConference.com number.
* Everyone enters the same access code associated with your account to join the call.

What OS, devices and browsers do you support?

#### FreeConference.com supports the following:

####  

#### Operating Systems
* **Windows:** If you're using Windows 7 or newer, you should be good to go.
* **macOS:** For Mac users, most recent versions will work.
* **Linux:** Popular choices like Ubuntu and Debian are compatible.
* **Mobile Operating Systems:**
  * iOS (iPhones and iPads)
  * Android (phones and tablets)

#### Devices
* **Desktop and Laptop Computers:**  Use your Windows PC or Mac.
* **Smartphones and Tablets:**  Download our mobile apps for free conference calling on the go.
* **Traditional Phones:** You can even dial in from a regular phone using our numbers.

#### Browsers

**Note**: make sure your browser(s) is up-to-date. Supported browsers include:
* Google Chrome
* Mozilla Firefox
* Safari
* Microsoft Edge

**Important Note:** While you can join a meeting using most browsers, screen sharing functionality
is currently limited to Google Chrome

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

# Gorakhnath Group

### Good Chemistry, Assured

## Our Company Story

Who We Are

Gorakhnath Group embarked on its journey in 2012 with the establishment of its first formaldehyde
plant. At the outset, our operations were modest, producing 800 tons per month.


Through dedication, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, we have experienced
remarkable growth over the years. Today, we proudly operate at a production capacity of 270 tons
daily, amounting to over 8,000 tons per month.


As the largest formaldehyde manufacturer in Uttar Pradesh, India, Gorakhnath Group has become a
trusted name in the chemical manufacturing industry. Our success is built upon a foundation of
quality, reliability, and a relentless drive to meet the evolving needs of our clients.
 

[Pipetting Samples and Test Tube Photo]

## Products & Services

Gorakhnath Group

### Formaldehyde

Discover our high-quality formaldehyde 37% solution, trusted in various industrial applications. We
are dedicated to excellence, ensuring our product meets the highest standards of quality and safety.
With swift delivery across Northern India, we aim to meet your needs efficiently, establishing
ourselves as a leading provider in the industry. Choose us for reliable solutions and unparalleled
service.

### Formaldehyde Resins

Our innovative formaldehyde-based resins, meticulously developed by a dedicated R&D team from
leading institutes, are designed for superior bonding and are ideal for various industrial
applications. With a focus on quality and performance, our resins provide excellent thermal
stability, ensuring long-lasting results for your projects. Experience the reliability and advanced
technology behind our customized formaldehyde-based resins today!

### PLYWOOD & LAMINATES

Explore our high-quality plywood and laminates, designed to elevate your projects with durability
and style. Our plywood is sourced from premium materials, ensuring strength and stability for
various applications. Paired with our exquisite laminates, available in a variety of finishes and
colors, you'll achieve a polished look that meets both aesthetic and functional needs. Perfect for
furniture, cabinetry, and interior design, our products promise longevity and timeless appeal.

[Office Photo]

## Team

Dedication. Expertise. Passion.

At Gorakhnath Group, we believe that our greatest asset is our people. Our success is driven by a
passionate, skilled, and dedicated team that works tirelessly to deliver excellence. From
experienced industry experts to innovative thinkers, each member of our team contributes to the
growth and strength of our company. Together, we share a commitment to quality, integrity, and
continuous improvement, ensuring we remain leaders in the chemical manufacturing industry.

Brij Mohan

Industrialist

Brij Mohan is a seasoned business professional with over 50 years of experience. His expertise has
helped him navigate various challenges and opportunities, making him a respected in the community.
Brij's commitment to excellence continues to inspire others in the ever-evolving marketplace.

Shantanu Agarwal

B.Tech MTech, IIT Kanpur

Shantanu is a technical expert whose has worked with ISRO and DRDO. His commitment to excellence and
for technology continue to push boundaries.
* [[LinkedIn]][11]

Saransh Agarwal

BITS Pilani

Saransh is a software engineer with experience in Market Risk. He develops solutions to assess
financial risks effectively, contributing significantly with his analytical mindset and technical
expertise.

### ホルムアルデヒド対策は
### モルディフィート

発がん性物質であるホルムアルデヒド
除去を目的とした専用コート剤として
安全安心な住環境の改善を提供します
[製品特性][19]
[シックハウス症候群の原因と対策]

### シックハウス症候群について

症状は、目がチカチカする、鼻水、のどの乾燥、
吐き気、頭痛、湿疹など人によってさまざまです。
[さらに詳しくはこちら][20]
[ホルムアルデヒド除去対策の施工]

### シックハウス対策実績

室内の化学物質対策により、
安全・安心な住宅での生活が
実現しました。
[さらに詳しくはこちら][21]

# 一人一人を健康へ導く

2006年2月、ホルムアルデヒド除去コート剤が開発されました。
室内に充満したホルムアルデヒドによるシックハウス症候群などの体調不良に
悩み苦しんでいた方が初めてのお客様となりました。

これからも日本のみならず世界中の人々をホルムアルデヒドによる
健康被害から守るため”モルディフィート”は提供され続けます。

[
シックハウス症候群とは？
][22]

## 素早く、大量に、ホルムアルデヒドを吸着除去

多くのホルムアルデヒド除去剤の課題は、即効性と長期効果性能でしたが、実現する事が出来ておりませんでし
た。

ホルムアルデヒド除去剤のモルディフィートは、独自技術革新によって今まで出来なかった即効性と長期効果の
両方を維持できる技術的な課題をクリアしました。

[
モルディフィートの特長
][23]
[No more formaldehyde]

## ホルムアルデヒド除去剤
## モルディフィートの特徴

モルディフィート最大の特徴は、その技術構造にあります。

室内に充満するホルムアルデヒドを、実際に除去する成分は、”シリカ”という物質です。

一見ただの液体に見えるモルディフィートですが、塗布した表面を拡大して見ると”
シリカ”成分は、極細の結晶針のような形をしています。

この極細の結晶針１本１本がびっしりと塗布表面を埋め尽くし、覆っている状態です。

なんとその数・・・・・

**1㎠あたり4億本**

その１本１本に、ホルムアルデヒドの成分が隙間なくしっかりと吸着されます。

**このテクノロジーにより、瞬時にそして強力にホルムアルデヒドを除去出来る理由です。**

この技術構造を作ることが出来るホルムアルデヒド除去剤は、”モルディフィート”だけなのです。

**
**

[モルディフィート塗布表面 拡大イメージ図]モルディフィート塗布表面 拡大イメージ図
[モルディフィート塗布表面状態イメージ図]モルディフィート塗布表面状態イメージ図
[
技術構造をもっと詳しく
][24]

## 安心・安全な製品を届けます

**①安全性**
毒性試験にて、製品の安全性を確認済み
日本食品分析センターにて、毒性物質の溶出が無いことを確認しております。

**②信頼性**
モルディフィートは、国際連合工業開発機構（UNIDO）が実施した厳しい品質及び製品の審査をクリアし、優れ
た製品の証として2022年の９月にUNIDOの” STePP※”に登録されました。

^{※}STePPとは、"Sustainable Technology Promotion Platform"
（日本語：サスティナブル技術普及プラットフォーム）の略称です。
開発途上国・新興国の持続的な産業開発の為に、様々な日本の優れた技術が紹介されております。

[UNIDO ITPO TOKYO STePP]
[
UNIDO STePP製品掲載ページ
][25]

## あらゆる場所や製品のホルムアルデヒドを除去

[No more formaldehyde]
[Plywood manufacturer]

室内壁面や家具などに直接塗布、または工場にて合板や木製家具製造時にモルディフィートを導入することも可
能です。

[
使用場所ページへ
][26]

## ホルムアルデヒド対策は、是非当社にお任せ下さい

長年の研究開発を経て誕生した、”モルディフィート”。

目に見えない有害物質”ホルムアルデヒド”を除去して当たり前の日常生活、そして本来の健康な身体を取り戻し
ましょう。

まずはお気軽にお問い合わせください。

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

  preservative, which has a good effect on inhibiting the growth of microorganisms, and can inhibit

### GLOBAL ENERGY OPERATOR

QatarEnergy LNG is a unique global energy operator in terms of size, service and reliability. We
operate 14 liquefied natural gas (LNG) trains with a total annual production capacity of 77 million
tonnes. This makes QatarEnergy LNG the largest LNG producer in the world. Established in 1984,
QatarEnergy LNG develops and produces hydrocarbons from the world’s largest non-associated natural
gas field. QatarEnergy LNG is committed to safety, environmental sustainability, flawless project
delivery, and the reliability and efficiency of our production facilities, to play a key role in
Qatar’s efforts to become a global leader in the LNG industry.

Click [here][82] to read QatarEnergy LNG's Direction Statement.

gas field. QatarEnergy LNG is committed to safety, environmental sustainability, flawless project

## Latest News

[ [Cost Surges for Global Buyers.png] ][139]
July 24, 2026
[Cost Surges for Global Buyers: Impacts of Abolished Export Rebates on Phosphorus Flame Retardants &
DBNPA][140]

The abolition of China’s 13% export VAT rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and DBNPA pushes up
procurement costs for global buyers. Combined with volatile upstream phosphorus raw material prices,
suppliers keep adjusting quotations. Widely adopted in plastics, new energy, water treatment and
coatings, these chemicals squeeze overseas end-users’ profits. While large manufacturers ease
pressure through internal optimization, traders transfer cost increases downstream. Experts suggest
long-term contracts to hedge spot price volatility.

[Read More][141]
[ [Export VAT Rebates Canceled.png] ][142]
July 17, 2026
[China Cancels Export VAT Rebates for Phosphorus Flame Retardants and DBNPA Starting April 1,
2026][143]

Issued via China’s Announcement No.2 of 2026, a new policy cancels the original 13% export VAT
rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and industrial biocide DBNPA starting April 1, 2026, judged
by customs declaration date. Covering TCPP, ammonium polyphosphate and other mainstream chemicals,
the policy aims to upgrade resource-intensive chemical industries. It brings immediate cost hikes
for global importers, triggering frequent quotation adjustments and expected long-term price
fluctuations across the phosphorus chemical supply chain.

hydrogenation catalysts. It owns high sulfur content of over 68.1%, decomposes stably at moderate
temperatures to activate catalysts and avoid coking, outperforming DMS in efficiency and cost
control. Widely applied in refineries, ethylene plants and fine chemical synthesis. As a large
Chinese manufacturer with 20,000-ton annual capacity, we supply certified products, customized
technical schemes and stable global logistics for worldwide industrial clients.

long-term contracts to hedge spot price volatility.

Agriculture Sector with a myriad compound of chemicals, **Suvidhi Industries** has become an

**About Us**




Successfully serving diverse industries like Food & Beverage, Leather, Pharmaceutical & Textile and
Agriculture Sector with a myriad compound of chemicals, **Suvidhi Industries** has become an
integrated chemical company, developing its business in India as well as several countries of the
world. Ever since our inception in 1996, We have been growing consistently through supplying
unmatched quality chemical for different application to our wide client base. We are a leading
manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler/distributor, supplier and trader of a comprehensive range of
chemicals and acids such as **Acetic Acid, Aluminum Sulphate-Ferric, Bleaching Powder, Formic Acid,
Caustic Soda Flakes, Caustic Soda Lye, Liquid Chlorine**, etc. Our company is also an eminent dealer
of Shriram Alkali & Chemicals (DCM), Jhagadia. Our products are widely appreciated by our vast
clientele as well as meet varied requirements of industries like chemical industry, food industry
and many more.

With about two decades of experience in chemical industry and profound knowledge in developing
unique, cost-efficient and high-performing chemical solutions, we have sustainably progressed. Our
sophisticated chemical processing infrastructure and innovative formulation know-how amplify our
ability to provide highly effective and Eco-efficient chemicals. With our dedication and commitment
towards high quality of products, we have successfully established ourselves as a trustworthy
company in the industry. We continually strive to work hard in order to improve the quality of our
products and also to widen our reach in this industry.

We introduce ourselves as a dealer of Shriram Alkali & Chemicals (DCM) Jhagadia. We are dealing in
products like Caustic Soda Lye 48%, Caustic Soda Flakes, Hydrochloric Acid 30%, Sodium Hypo Chlorite
(all grades), Bleaching Powder, & Liquid Chlorine, since last Nine years. We have been providing
more responsible consumer and commercial chemical solutions to Textile & Food Industries, Paper &
Paint Industries, etc.

Suvidhi Industries a developing trader of chemicals at Vapi was conceived in the year 2000. In short
span of Nine years the company has grown up in terms of variety of products, quantity of products
