## What Is Professional Cleaning and When Do You Need It?

If cleaning still doesn’t feel “clean”, you’re not alone. Here are some common questions to help you
understand when professional cleaning makes sense and what to expect.




### What is included in a professional cleaning service?

Professional cleaning goes beyond basic wiping and mopping. It involves:
* Targeting hidden dirt, grease, and buildup
* Using the right equipment and cleaning agents for each surface
* Following a structured process for consistent results
* Ensuring proper checks after cleaning

It’s not just about making a space look clean, it’s about cleaning it properly.

### When should I engage in professional cleaning?

You should consider professional cleaning when:
* After renovation or construction works
* Before moving in or handing over a unit
* When dirt, grease, or dust buildup becomes difficult to manage
* When regular cleaning is no longer effective

### How is this different from regular hourly cleaning?

Regular hourly cleaning focuses on basic upkeep.

Professional cleaning is more structured and detailed, addressing deeper issues such as
post-renovation dust, stubborn grease, and hard-to-reach areas, using proper tools and methods.




### How long does a cleaning session take?

It depends on the size and condition of the space.

That’s why we start with a site assessment, so we can recommend the right scope, time, and approach
for your specific situation.





### Do I need to supervise the cleaning?

No. 

Our team follows a structured process, and each job is carried out with proper oversight to ensure
consistency and quality, so you don’t have to manage the work yourself.





### Is it worth the cost?

Professional cleaning saves time, reduces risk, and ensures better results — especially for more
complex cleaning needs.

Most customers see the difference immediately after the first session.

 

Still not sure what applies to your situation?

## What Is Professional Cleaning and When Do You Need It?

If cleaning still doesn’t feel “clean”, you’re not alone. Here are some common questions to help you
understand when professional cleaning makes sense and what to expect.




### What is included in a professional cleaning service?

Professional cleaning goes beyond basic wiping and mopping. It involves:
* Targeting hidden dirt, grease, and buildup
* Using the right equipment and cleaning agents for each surface
* Following a structured process for consistent results
* Ensuring proper checks after cleaning

It’s not just about making a space look clean, it’s about cleaning it properly.

### When should I engage in professional cleaning?

You should consider professional cleaning when:
* After renovation or construction works
* Before moving in or handing over a unit
* When dirt, grease, or dust buildup becomes difficult to manage
* When regular cleaning is no longer effective

### How is this different from regular hourly cleaning?

Regular hourly cleaning focuses on basic upkeep.

Professional cleaning is more structured and detailed, addressing deeper issues such as
post-renovation dust, stubborn grease, and hard-to-reach areas, using proper tools and methods.




### How long does a cleaning session take?

It depends on the size and condition of the space.

That’s why we start with a site assessment, so we can recommend the right scope, time, and approach
for your specific situation.





### Do I need to supervise the cleaning?

No. 

Our team follows a structured process, and each job is carried out with proper oversight to ensure
consistency and quality, so you don’t have to manage the work yourself.





### Is it worth the cost?

Professional cleaning saves time, reduces risk, and ensures better results — especially for more
complex cleaning needs.

Most customers see the difference immediately after the first session.

 

Still not sure what applies to your situation?

Indoor Air Quality Testing

## Indoor Air Quality Testing in Singapore

Before we recommend any treatment, we test your air. A professional indoor air quality assessment
measures **formaldehyde (HCHO), carbon dioxide, and humidity** using calibrated equipment, not the
consumer-grade detectors you'll find online. The same-day readings are explained on the spot, with
the WHO and NEA reference thresholds shown alongside, so you can see exactly where your space
stands.

Homeowners typically request indoor air testing after a renovation, when new furniture arrives,
before a newborn moves in, ahead of a property purchase, or following an illness in the household.
For offices, schools, childcare centres, and clinics, regular IAQ assessments form part of standard
facilities hygiene.

**What we measure**

HCHO, CO₂, humidity — at calibrated lab-grade accuracy, not consumer-gadget estimates.

**Where we sample**

Bedrooms, nurseries, built-in wardrobes, kitchens, and any space with new carpentry or paint.

**What you receive**

Same-day readings explained on the spot, benchmarked against the WHO 0.1 mg/m³ formaldehyde
guideline.

**When we bundle it**

Included free with every formaldehyde treatment booking — or quoted standalone on request.

Indoor Air Quality Testing

## Indoor Air Quality Testing in Singapore

Before we recommend any treatment, we test your air. A professional indoor air quality assessment
measures **formaldehyde (HCHO), carbon dioxide, and humidity** using calibrated equipment, not the
consumer-grade detectors you'll find online. The same-day readings are explained on the spot, with
the WHO and NEA reference thresholds shown alongside, so you can see exactly where your space
stands.

Homeowners typically request indoor air testing after a renovation, when new furniture arrives,
before a newborn moves in, ahead of a property purchase, or following an illness in the household.
For offices, schools, childcare centres, and clinics, regular IAQ assessments form part of standard
facilities hygiene.

**What we measure**

HCHO, CO₂, humidity — at calibrated lab-grade accuracy, not consumer-gadget estimates.

**Where we sample**

Bedrooms, nurseries, built-in wardrobes, kitchens, and any space with new carpentry or paint.

**What you receive**

Same-day readings explained on the spot, benchmarked against the WHO 0.1 mg/m³ formaldehyde
guideline.

**When we bundle it**

Included free with every formaldehyde treatment booking — or quoted standalone on request.

Voyage, a subsidiary of Henan D.R. Construction Group, inherits over 70 years of industry heritage
and carries out trade relying on the group’s own factories (with a [hardwood plywood sheets
production factory][59] in Nigeria and domestic factories in China). Founded in 1954, Henan D.R.
Construction Group has developed from a construction enterprise into a diversified company with
design, construction and building materials manufacturing capabilities, and has implemented numerous
engineering projects in North America, the Middle East, Central Asia, Africa, South Asia and
Southeast Asia. We are a high-end eco-friendly building materials supplier dedicated to serving
European and American B2B procurement clients, and we are actively developing the Middle East,
Central Asia and Australian markets to expand our global layout. We have core advantages in premium
[hardwood veneer plywood][60], [laminate flooring][61] and innovative [soft stone panel][62], with
complete international certifications and rich overseas project cases, committed to becoming your
one-stop partner for high-end building materials.

[read more][63]

[WPC decking][66], and [MCM Stone][67] in high-end hotels, modern offices, and large-scale
infrastructure projects. We are committed to delivering aesthetic excellence and lasting durability
for every international project we support.
